title: Set Matrix Zeroes
contract: For a nonempty rectangular matrix, zero every row and column containing an original zero.
brute: int rows=a.length,cols=a[0].length;int[][] copy=new int[rows][];for(int r=0;r<rows;r++)copy[r]=a[r].clone();for(int r=0;r<rows;r++)for(int c=0;c<cols;c++)if(copy[r][c]==0){for(int j=0;j<cols;j++)a[r][j]=0;for(int i=0;i<rows;i++)a[i][c]=0;emit("Zero the original zero's row and column","matrix",a);}return a;
reasoning: Preserve an original copy so newly written zeroes do not trigger extra erasures.
Reuse the first row and column as marker arrays and separately remember whether those borders originally contained zeroes.
Apply interior markers before changing the borders. This ordering preserves information while using only two boolean flags.
